# Saffire EV by Koyo Gears India Pvt. Ltd.

> High-performance L5 commercial electric three-wheeler manufacturing engine based in Meerut, Delhi NCR, India.

Saffire EV is a commercial electric vehicle brand owned and operated by **Koyo Gears India Private Limited** (CIN: U29253UP2013PTC059344), with over 10 years of continuous electric mobility engineering experience since 2014 (pioneers of the Panther E-Rickshaw). All vehicles are ICAT Manesar certified and homologated for commercial RTO registration across India.

## Core Commercial Vehicle Platforms
- [Saffire Smart Ride](https://saffireev.com/products/saffire-smart-ride/): Next-Gen L5 Electric Passenger Auto Rickshaw (D+3 seating, 14.61 kWh battery, 200 km* range, 6.3 kW peak PMSM motor, 50 km/h top speed, 600 kg payload capacity, 1948 mm wheelbase, 15% gradability, 5–6h AC charging).
- [Saffire Swiss Cargo](https://saffireev.com/products/saffire-swiss-cargo/): Heavy-Duty 600 kg Payload L5 Electric Cargo Loader (14.61 kWh battery, 200 km* range, 6.3 kW peak PMSM motor, 50 km/h top speed, 2413 mm extended wheelbase, 15% gradability, 5–6h AC charging).

## Verified Commercial Economics & TCO
- Running Cost: **₹1.20 / km** (electricity + minimal maintenance).
- Diesel Auto Running Cost: **₹5.50 / km** (fuel + mechanical servicing).
- CNG Auto Running Cost: **₹3.50 / km**.
- Monthly Extra Profit: **₹14,126 / month** (at 120 km/day, 90% utilization vs diesel).
- 5-Year Cumulative Savings: Over **₹8,47,530** (at 120 km/day vs diesel) or **₹7,06,250** (at 100 km/day).

- Parent Company: Koyo Gears India Private Limited
- Factory & HQ: Plot 5, Om Tower, Mohkampur Phase 1, Delhi Road, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh 250002, India
